senses.en: to move past someone or something

example.en: A bus passed us on the narrow road.
example.zh: 一辆公交车在窄路上从我们旁边驶过。

senses.en: to hand something to someone

example.en: Please pass me the salt.
example.zh: 请把盐递给我。

senses.en: to succeed in a test or course

example.en: She passed her driving test on the first try.
example.zh: 她第一次就通过了驾照考试。

senses.en: a card or ticket that allows you to enter or travel

example.en: He showed his pass at the station gate.
example.zh: 他在车站闸口出示了通行证。

senses.en: a trip in which you visit several places for pleasure or interest

example.en: We took a bus tour of the old city.
example.zh: 我们乘巴士游览了老城区。

senses.en: to travel around a place or several places

example.en: They toured the coast by bicycle.
example.zh: 他们骑自行车游览了海岸。

senses.en: a short visit around a building or place to look at it

example.en: The school offers a tour of the science labs.
example.zh: 学校提供科学实验室的参观活动。

senses.en: the part of the face used for breathing and smelling

example.en: She touched her nose gently.
example.zh: 她轻轻碰了碰鼻子。

senses.en: the ability to notice or smell things

example.en: He has a good nose for a bargain.
example.zh: 他很会淘便宜货。

senses.en: the front part of a vehicle or aircraft

example.en: The plane's nose dipped as it landed.
example.zh: 飞机着陆时机头向下倾斜。

senses.en: to search for something by looking around

example.en: Reporters nosed around the office for clues.
example.zh: 记者在办公室里四处打听线索。

senses.en: a small piece broken off from a hard material

example.en: A chip of paint fell from the wall.
example.zh: 一块漆皮从墙上脱落了。

senses.en: a long thin strip of potato fried in oil (British English); a thin crispy slice of fried potato (American English)

example.en: We ordered fish and chips by the sea.
example.zh: 我们在海边点了炸鱼薯条。

senses.en: a small electronic component that stores or processes information

example.en: The phone needs a faster chip.
example.zh: 这款手机需要更快的芯片。

senses.en: to break a small piece off something

example.en: Be careful not to chip the mug.
example.zh: 小心别把杯子磕出缺口。

senses.en: a device that captures sound and sends it to a speaker or recording system

example.en: She spoke into the microphone so everyone could hear her.
example.zh: 她对着麦克风说话，好让大家都能听见。

senses.en: a thin white layer of ice crystals that forms on cold surfaces
senses.zh: 霜；表面凝结的白色冰晶

example.en: There was frost on the car windows this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上车窗上结了霜。

senses.en: a period or condition of freezing weather that can damage plants

example.en: A late frost damaged the young apple blossoms.
example.zh: 一场晚霜冻坏了幼嫩的苹果花。

senses.en: to cover a cake or other food with icing

example.en: She frosted the cake with vanilla icing.
example.zh: 她给蛋糕抹了香草糖霜。

senses.en: a police officer

example.en: The officer asked to see his driver's license.
example.zh: 警官要求查看他的驾照。

senses.en: a person with authority in the armed forces

example.en: The officer ordered the troops to advance.
example.zh: 军官命令部队前进。

senses.en: a person who holds an official position in an organization

example.en: The club elected a new treasurer and other officers.
example.zh: 俱乐部选出了新的财务主管和其他官员。
